newsitem.title: MEXICO: Empaq halts boxboard production 5 weeks.
newsitem.headline: Empaq halts boxboard production 5 weeks.

text.p: Empaques Ponderosa SA (Empaq) has stopped boxboard production for five weeks because of machinery substitution at the company's plant, Empaq planning director Humberto Cano said.
He told Reuters the output halt will not affect prices or supply because the company has imported about 16,000 tonnes of boxboard for the past six months in anticipation of the stoppage.

"The stoppage began on Tuesday and we expect it will last five weeks," Cano said. "Since about six months ago we began an import program to raise inventory and have the necessary supply during the stoppage."
The company director said the new machinery will expansion will increase annual capacity to 180,000 tonnes, compared with the current 150,000 tonnes.
Empaq supplies half of the national boxboard demand and the company's only plant is in the central state of Queretaro. Boxboard is the company's sole product.
